verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents an explicit 'amount splits' feature for routing payin funds among parties (rainforest-docs-6, rainforest-docs-28), confirming multi-party fund splitting exists as a first-class capability tied to payins. However the docs only describe a 3-step setup with no detail on split objects being independently reversible/adjustable after the fact, no mention of the platform 'taking a cut' mechanics, and no lifecycle/update API for existing splits. Missing for 10: documented split object schema, reverse/adjust-after-the-fact endpoints, and independent corroboration of split behavior in production.
